# A second customer's invoice, paid the same day, for the same figure, into
# the same account, with the same memo — and its own guid, naming a transaction
# this book does not hold.
#
# Two customers each paying 100.00 into one account on one day is ordinary, and
# a printed invoice carries the guid of the book it came from, so both blocks
# reach the duplicate-payment guard with everything it compares identical. What
# separates them is only that they are different invoices' money.
customer "C-OTHER"
	name: "Other Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-OTHER"
	customer_id: "C-OTHER"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-OTHER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Paid"
		txn_guid: "feedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedface"
